title: Cut Susi 0.21.52: bump the engine version and ship it from a native Linux x86_64 host
goal: Release main as 0.21.52. v0.21.51's published binaries were built without the local engine (fixed on main by #1668, release builds select --features local-engine); this cut ships the engine. Bump the seven engine-version manifests, Cargo.lock, the README badge and the three governance ledgers together (matching fc4df627b), and land the bump through cargo local-workflow ship on a native x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu host. Then build the Linux x86_64 artifacts from the shipped commit with the product features, run the former release.yml offline checks on them, and publish them as v0.21.52; the Windows x86_64 artifacts are added to the same release from the CEO's Windows host. If the release tooling refuses for a structural reason, report the exact refusal instead of forging receipts, refs or coordinator trust inputs. Installed production promotion is a separate, evidence-gated step and is not claimed by this cut.
